title.narrative: Anti Malaria Campaign, Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medicine - Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Sri Lanka, Malaria, Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (MOH)This program has the following goals: Malaria free Sri Lanka. The objectives of this program are: To be eligible for WHO certification of Malaria Free Sri Lanka. To maintain zero mortality due to indigenous malaria. To prevent re-introduction of indigenous malaria in Sri Lanka
